replacement_spec.body: Amplification is the deliberate increase in the magnitude or intensity of a carried content, in two principal domains. (1) Physical: the increase in the amplitude or power of a signal by an active stage — parameters: an input signal, a gain factor (the ratio of output magnitude to input magnitude, reported linearly or in decibels), and a linear operating region bounded by a capacity limit beyond which the stage saturates; the mechanism is power conversion from a supply through active elements (valves, transistors, op-amps). (2) Rhetorical (auxesis): the strengthening of a claim or image by elaboration — parameters: a base claim, successive elaborations with repetition and intensification, and a cumulative effect that exceeds mere restatement. Persistence: the physical sense persists through circuit design standards, electronics and acoustics textbooks, and calibration practice; the rhetorical sense persists through rhetorical handbooks, the teaching of composition, and the literary tradition. replacement_spec.body: Optimization is a human-made formal method of selecting values for a set of decision variables so as to maximize or minimize a specified objective function over a feasible region. Parameters: (1) the decision space — the variables and their domains; (2) the objective function — the scalar quantity to be extremized; (3) the constraint set — equalities and inequalities restricting feasible solutions (unconstrained optimization is the special case where the feasible region is the whole space); (4) the solution procedure — an algorithm or calculus method (gradient descent, Newton's method, linear programming) that navigates the decision space toward an optimum. It persists through mathematical notation and theorems (convexity, KKT conditions, duality), computational implementations in numerical libraries, and institutionalized practice across operations research, engineering, economics, and machine learning. Without the formal pairing of objective function and constraint structure, optimization degenerates into preference or trial-and-error, losing the guarantees (existence, optimality, convergence) that define it.
